claims.text: The dataset used in the paper consists of tweets classified into harassment and non-harassment categories, with sub-categories for indirect harassment, sexual harassment, and physical harassment.
The dataset is divided into a training set, validation set, and test set, and it was published for a specific workshop on online harassment language categorization.
The dataset is imbalanced, particularly with fewer instances of indirect and physical harassment in the training set compared to the validation and test sets.
